answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The juniper edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 60 clones produces a signature the pulse analysis flags immediately. Someone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the zenith settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
